name: Praying For The Lost
overview: Scripture reveals that praying for the lost is a vital expression of Christ-centered intercession, as Paul exemplifies his heartfelt desire for the salvation of Israel (Romans 10:1). Jesus highlights the great need for laborers to gather the plentiful harvest of souls (Matthew 9:37), while emphasizing His mission to seek and save the lost (Luke 19:10). True salvation begins with God drawing individuals to Christ (John 6:44), transforming hardened hearts into ones receptive to the gospel (Ezekiel 36:26), opening their eyes to turn from darkness to light and receive forgiveness through faith (Acts 26:18). Thus, praying for the lost aligns with God’s redemptive work of renewing hearts and bringing sinners into His kingdom.
